ns2:course.label: Seminar in Business Admin
ns2:course.description: Special topics in the general area of business. Topics are selected by the instructor at the beginning of each term. Approved for letter and S/U grading. May be repeated in the same term and/or separate terms as topics vary. Unlimited credit hours for graduate and professional students.
